game.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
game.blurb: Story-driven first-person shooter from Machine Games, published by Bethesda Softworks, released 2014-05-19. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement names (every condition is hidden).

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Story milestones such as saving Fergus or Wyatt, the resistance, the laser, London and the final liberation. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Gold and Secrets
chapters.summary: Achievements named for gold, secrets and "the lives of others"; their conditions are hidden.

chapters.title: Super Hero and Über Hero
chapters.summary: Two rare achievements whose conditions are hidden.

chapters.title: Skills and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Achievements named for skills and gear: Scout, knife throwing and sheaths, magazines, reloads, Endurance, dual-wielding, grenade pouches, the LKW and more.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). All 50 Steam achievements are hidden, so every one is placed by its name only, and every placement is a guess. The nine story-sounding names (ach_1 to ach_9) are the campaign chapter; "Fergus saved" (59.3%) and "Wyatt saved" (44.6%) both exist. "All that glitters", "Heart of gold", "The lives of others" and "Secrets revealed I" to "IV" (5% to 19%) are grouped as collectibles. "Super hero" (13.5%) and "Über hero" (6.7%) are rare and get their own small chapter; what they need is not in the data. The other 32 (ach_19 to ach_50) are named for skills and gear and sit in the skills chapter. The store list has two apps named "Wolfenstein: The New Order": 201810 (schema "Wolfenstein: The New Order") and 288570 (schema "Wolfenstein: The New Order LV"), with the same 50 achievement names; RAWG also has a separate "German Edition" entry. App 201810 was used. StrategyWiki has a stub (completion stage 0, marked as a stub): only Controls and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay and Walkthrough are not. wolfenstein.fandom.com answers the API under "Wolfenstein: The New Order" with about 201 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
